title: Section 480 BNSS — Magistrate bail in non-bailable cases

content.overview: Section 480 is bail before a Court other than the High Court or Court of Session in a non-bailable case. It replaces CrPC 437.
content.study: Death or life cases are tightly restricted at this forum. Women, children and infirm accused have enacted consideration. Sessions and High Court power is 483.
